title: Builder Responsibility Allocation for Delay Waivers — Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
Where a closing has moved both because construction slipped and because the buyer asked to move it, the builder-delay waiver on a Builder Extended Rate Lock extension charge follows the builder's share of the delay.

**Allocation.** The construction slip is the calendar days from the Home Purchase Agreement's contract completion date to its estimated completion date, and the buyer move days are the buyer-requested closing extensions written on the agreement times the closing extension days of the agreement's collection. Where the agreement carries a buyer-requested closing extension and a construction slip of at least one day, the builder share is the construction slip divided by the sum of the construction slip and the buyer move days; where it carries a buyer-requested closing extension and no construction slip, the builder share is zero; otherwise the builder share is one. The waiver percent of the extension charge is multiplied by the builder share before the result is rounded half up to the cent.

The closing extension days of the collection are the Home Purchase Agreement figure for the calendar days one closing extension adds to the scheduled closing date, for the collection the agreement is written in.

## Branches

| Buyer-requested closing extensions on the agreement | Construction slip | Builder share |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | 1 day or more | slip divided by (slip plus buyer move days) |
| one or more | none | zero |
| none | any | one |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

Contract completion 1 May, estimated completion 22 May: slip 21 days. One buyer-requested closing extension written, in a collection whose closing extension adds 7 days: buyer move days 7. Builder share 21 divided by 28, which is 0.75. An extension charge of USD 515.43 at a waiver percent of 100: 515.43 multiplied by 0.75 is 386.5725, rounded half up USD 386.57.

All inputs are read from the Home Purchase Agreement record of the agreement the lock finances.
